QUESTIONS & ANSWERS

Before you visit

Do your staff speak English?+

Our staff mainly speak Japanese. We use translation tools to communicate with international guests, including during the consultation.

Is this a hair wash or a haircut?+

No. Our dry head spa is a head massage without water. It is a relaxation treatment, not a haircut.

Can men book a treatment?+

Yes. Men are welcome at Lakka.

Can I pay by card?+

The salon lists Visa, Mastercard, JCB, American Express, Diners Club and Discover.

Do I need a Japanese phone number to book?+

Our new booking page is being prepared. International phone number support has not yet been confirmed.
